requirement: Membrane modules shall carry a 7-year full replacement warranty.
response: Offered the standard 10-year warranty: full replacement for 5 years, prorated for years 6 to 10.

requirement: All wetted parts and the frame shall be Type 316 stainless steel.
response: Priced Type 316 stainless steel frame and wetted parts as an option to the standard 304L frame.

requirement: Liquidated damages of $2,500 per calendar day, with no cap.
response: Accepted liquidated damages of $500 per day, capped at 5 percent of the contract price.

requirement: Payment of 100 percent on delivery of equipment.
response: Asked for 10 percent with order, 80 percent on delivery, and 10 percent on startup.

requirement: Band screens shall be Manufacturer X Model 300, or approved equal.
response: Offered our band screen as an approved equal and filed the approved-equal request before the deadline.

requirement: A factory-trained technician on site for not less than 15 working days.
response: Included 5 days per equipment type and priced extra days at the per-diem rate.

requirement: A 90-day pilot test with the proposed membranes before award.
response: Provided a containerized pilot unit for 90 days; rental and operator support were billed separately.

requirement: Guarantee of permeate turbidity of 0.1 NTU at all times.
response: Offered 0.2 NTU or less 95 percent of the time, the standard membrane guarantee.

requirement: Equipment warranty of 24 months from substantial completion.
response: Offered 12 months from startup or 18 months from shipment; an extended warranty was priced separately.

requirement: Clarifier drive continuous torque of not less than 60,000 ft-lb with an AGMA 20-year rating.
response: Confirmed a drive sized above the required torque, rated for 20 years under AGMA.

requirement: Shop drawings within 30 days of notice to proceed.
response: Committed to 8 weeks after the purchase order; 6 weeks was possible at an expedite charge.

requirement: All equipment shall comply with Build America, Buy America.
response: Confirmed BABA compliance and priced the domestic content premium separately.

requirement: A performance bond of 100 percent of the contract price.
response: Provided the bond and listed its cost as a separate line item.

requirement: Maximum net flux of 10 gfd at design average flow.
response: Sized the membrane area for the specified flux; noted SiC can run at higher flux if the owner allows.

requirement: A process performance guarantee for the equipment supplied.
response: Issued a written process performance warranty after an engineering review of the influent data.

requirement: Proposal prices valid for 180 days.
response: Held prices for 90 days, with a published escalation index after that.

requirement: A 72-hour wet test of each clarifier mechanism.
response: Included the standard 24-hour wet test and priced the extra 48 hours.

requirement: Screenings capture ratio of not less than 90 percent, guaranteed.
response: Stated capture ratio as typical performance from published tests, without a guarantee.

requirement: O&M manuals 60 days before startup, in hard copy and electronic form.
response: Provided searchable PDF manuals 4 weeks before startup and two hard copies at turnover.

requirement: At least five installations of the same model operating for three years.
response: Listed five SiC MBR reference plants, two of them operating for more than three years.
